news.title: Crypto tax bills a work-in-progress as U.S. House lawmakers pose concerns

news.title: Securitize CEO says tokenized stocks could unlock a $5 trillion crypto market
news.summary: At a panel at ETHConf, Carlos Domingo argued that bringing stocks and exchange-traded funds onchain could unlock a market far larger than today's roughly $30 billion tokenized asset sector.

news.title: UK financial regulator moves to allow mutual funds 10% exposure to crypto ETNs
